Two APKs from here on: the phone console and a Jellyfin client for Android TV. And one repair
that matters more than either: video plays again.

## Video plays again

2.0.0 could browse a library but never play from it. Every stream stopped at a buffering
spinner, because the request reached the server with its HTTP headers mangled and was turned
away. Each header is now handed to the player on its own.

If you are on 2.0.0, this is the reason to update. Nothing plays without it.

## A second app for the television

- `sanctumd-tv-v2.1.0.apk` is a Jellyfin streaming client and nothing else. The dashboard, the
  service list, the widgets and the background services are removed from the TV build rather
  than merely hidden. It has one launchable screen and no way to reach the rest.
- Servers are found by broadcast on the local network. Quick Connect shows a code on the
  television that you approve on your phone, because typing a password with a remote control is
  miserable. Username and password still work where Quick Connect is switched off.
- A bare address is tried over https before http, and the sign-in screen says so when the
  connection it settled on is unencrypted.
- libmpv does the decoding, which is the whole point on a cheap stick: the codec gaps that make
  other clients stutter stop mattering. The panel's refresh rate is matched before playback
  begins, never during it.

It installs beside the phone app rather than over it: separate package, own icon. This is the
first television build, and it was driven with key events rather than an actual remote, so
anything that refuses to take focus is worth reporting.

## Small print

- With the app lock on, the task switcher no longer shows what the lock hides. The screen was
  covered on open, but Android had already taken its thumbnail for the recents list, and that
  one anybody could see. On Android 13 and up the thumbnail is suppressed while the lock is on.
  Screenshots keep working; only the preview goes.

## Installing

- Phone: `sanctumd-v2.1.0.apk`
- Android TV: `sanctumd-tv-v2.1.0.apk`

Android will ask you to allow installs from this source. Updating over an earlier build keeps
your configuration. `CHANGELOG.md` in the repository carries the detailed account.
